hooks.note: Swift trim() is trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines). In Kotlin this.trim() inside the extension calls the extension itself, because it shadows kotlin.text.trim in this package and in every file that imports it (ModelSettingsUrl, ModelChat), so a moblin:// or loxen:// settings URL with a stream ended in a StackOverflowError. trim(Char::isWhitespace) is kotlin.text's trim().

Same as HTRIM.1: this.substring(begin, end) inside the extension calls the extension itself, so hexStringToByteArray and every two-argument substring in this package ended in a StackOverflowError. subSequence is a member of String, which the extension cannot shadow.
